items.name: Casamigos
clues: A strong drink made from a plant that grows in Mexico.
Its founders had holiday homes next to each other in Mexico and made it for themselves and their friends, before selling it from 2013.
In 2017 a British drinks giant bought it for up to 1 billion dollars.
One founder is married to a supermodel; another is a Hollywood actor.
The actor is George Clooney, star of Ocean’s Eleven and the coffee-capsule adverts.
George Clooney’s tequila, whose name means “house of friends” in Spanish.

items.name: Fenty Beauty
clues: Make-up that was famous from day one for how many skin tones it catered for.
It launched in September 2017, made with the luxury group behind Louis Vuitton and Dior.
According to Forbes, it took about 570 million dollars in its first 15 months.
Its first foundation came in 40 shades, and other make-up brands soon rushed to offer more.
Its founder is a singer from Barbados who touched up her make-up with it live on stage at the 2023 Super Bowl.
Rihanna’s make-up brand, named after her surname.

items.name: Skims
clues: Underwear and loungewear, in lots of different skin tones.
It launched in 2019, after its first planned name was dropped following criticism.
In 2023 investors valued it at about 4 billion dollars.
It has made clothes for the US team at the Olympic Games.
Its founder is a reality-TV star and one of the most-followed people on Instagram.
Kim Kardashian’s brand, whose name is also what you do to milk to take the cream off.

items.name: Rare Beauty
clues: Make-up which, its founder says, is about feeling good rather than looking perfect.
It launched in September 2020, sold through Sephora.
It promised to raise 100 million dollars over ten years for mental health.
Its liquid blush went viral on TikTok in 2022.
Its founder was a Disney Channel child star who became a singer, and has talked openly about her own mental health.
Selena Gomez’s make-up brand; its first word means “unusual”.

items.name: Haig Club
clues: A Scottish drink in a bottle you might mistake for perfume.
It launched in 2014, made by a British drinks giant with a famous footballer and a pop music manager.
It’s a single grain Scotch whisky from Cameronbridge in Fife, Scotland’s oldest grain whisky distillery.
The square bottle is made of blue glass, inspired by the blue glasses that whisky blenders taste from.
The footballer is a former England captain who played for Manchester United and Real Madrid.
David Beckham’s whisky, named after one of Scotland’s oldest whisky-making families.

items.name: Naturally Pam
clues: Snacks and muesli for people who read the back of the packet.
You can buy it in one of Germany’s big drugstore chains.
Its products are organic, and the range has grown from snacks to an advent calendar.
Its founder is a fitness creator from Karlsruhe with more than ten million YouTube subscribers.
During lockdown, millions of people did her workout videos in their living rooms.
Pamela Reif’s snack brand.
